target_customer: Fintechs, neobanks and gig platforms that want to lend to their users without raising debt capital
problem: Platforms that want to offer loans to their users need debt capital, risk models and servicing, which they lack.
business_model: API and risk protocol for debt as a service, earning on loans originated with partner debt capital

founders.name: Kate Hiscox
previous_startups: Venzee (taken public on the TSX Venture Exchange, 2018)
founders.background_notes: YC page: Sivo is her sixth company, 15 plus years building companies.

founders.name: Dani Conejo Rico
founders.background_notes: YC page: product focused; one profile names her Daniela Conejo Rico.

competitors.name: Stripe Capital
competitors.what: Stripe lends to its own customers; the Sivo CEO positioned Sivo as Stripe for debt

technical_complexity.rationale: An API plus underwriting and capital markets plumbing; the hard parts were debt partnerships and risk modeling more than software.

defensibility.rationale: Depends on lender relationships and risk data that a funded rival or the platforms themselves could replicate; no moat was evidenced in sources.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Stripe already lent to its own customers in 2021; no source shows an incumbent copying or buying Sivo through 2025.

market_need_then: In March 2021 the company reported more than 100 companies in its pipeline including Uber and a 100 million dollar debt facility; these are company claims reported by TechCrunch, not independently verified.

branding.domain_note: Uses sivo.com; acquisition history not found.

identity.voice_and_tone: The pitch line Stripe for Debt anchors the voice.

branding.community_and_virality: Won PitchIt USA 2022 according to a Fintech Nexus page title; no community evidence found.

brand_strength.rationale: Press repeated the Stripe for debt framing but nothing shows brand driven growth.

outcome_analysis: Sivo raised a 5 million dollar seed at a reported 100 million dollar post money valuation within eight months of founding, then launched its API and a 2022 servicing partnership with Canopy. No Series A was confirmed and a profile says the CEO role changed in 2022. The company appears active, but its funding after the seed and its real traction are not publicly verified.
notes: The seed amount and valuation are reported by TechCrunch and repeated in search summaries of other outlets; the TechCrunch article names only Maple VC, YC investors from other summaries. CB Insights lists 10M on 2021-12 and Finder lists 4.5 euro million total; both unverified and not recorded as rounds. A profile says Ravi Sattuluri became CEO in 2022 with Hiscox moving to Chief Growth Officer; unverified. The sivo.com fetch was blocked by a rate limit, so the company website was not read.
